title: Apiary Sentinel Patterns
description: Machine-readable source of truth for credential and PII regex patterns. Compiled into the pre-push hook by assets/generate-hook.sh and read at runtime by Parliament Sentinel. Human-readable docs in protocol/sensitive-data-patterns.md.

patterns.name: credential.password-literal
patterns.notes: Catches 'password: foo', 'Password=', 'password = "..."'. Min 4 chars after assignment to reduce noise.

patterns.name: credential.token-literal
patterns.notes: Bearer/auth/access/secret tokens with >=20-char value. Bracket class rewritten: the old [A-Za-z0-9_\-.] made backslash literal inside POSIX brackets, so '\-.' parsed as a decreasing range, grep errored, and the error was swallowed — the pattern never matched anything.

patterns.name: credential.connection-string
patterns.notes: URL-form connection string with embedded password (scheme://user:pass@host). Rewritten from \s to [[:space:]]: inside a POSIX bracket expression \s is LITERAL backslash+s (both GNU and BSD grep), so the old class silently excluded the letter 's' from values — a connection string whose password contained an 's' was never matched.

patterns.name: credential.slack-token
patterns.notes: Slack API tokens, including xoxe- refresh tokens.

patterns.name: pii.us-phone
patterns.notes: US phone number. Excludes 1xx and 0xx area codes.

patterns.name: credential.github-token-oauth
patterns.notes: GitHub OAuth (gho_), server-to-server (ghs_), user-to-server (ghu_), and refresh (ghr_) tokens.

patterns.name: credential.azure-sas-sig
patterns.notes: Azure SAS token signature in a URL. False-positive risk: some legitimately-shared links carry sig= — but a SAS-bearing link IS a bearer credential; use the override flow for genuinely public samples.

patterns.name: credential.jwt
patterns.notes: Signed JWT (three base64url segments, header starting {"). Docs examples should use a truncated token or the override flow.

patterns.name: credential.bearer-header
patterns.notes: Authorization: Bearer header with a literal token value.
